description: Defines the PerformanceMetrics plugin class with nested classes and interfaces for logging, configuration, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing performance metrics collection and logging, with nested classes for configuration, notifications, and various observables.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::Config
classes.description: JSON configuration container for callsign and classname observables.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::Notification
classes.description: Handles plugin activation and deactivation notifications.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IStateMetricsLogger
classes.description: Extends IBasicMetricsLogger with resume and suspend logging.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IBrowserMetricsLogger
classes.description: Extends IStateMetricsLogger with browser-specific events like load finish, URL change, visibility, and page closure.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IObservable
classes.description: Interface for enabling/disabling observables and handling activation/deactivation.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::IPerfMetricsHandler
classes.description: Interface for performance metrics handlers with lifecycle methods.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::CallsignPerfMetricsHandler
classes.description: Handles metrics for a specific callsign, manages observable lifecycle.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::ClassnamePerfMetricsHandler
classes.description: Handles metrics for a specific class name, manages multiple observables.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::LoggerProxy
classes.description: Template class providing a logger instance for metrics.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::BasicObservable
classes.description: Implements observable behavior with logging for activation, deactivation, and uptime.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::StateObservable
classes.description: Extends BasicObservable with state control notifications (resume, suspend).

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::BrowserObservable
classes.description: Extends StateObservable with browser load, URL, visibility, and closure events.

classes.name: PerformanceMetrics::WebBrowserObservable
classes.description: Extends StateObservable with web browser load success/failure, URL, and page events.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin metadata as JSON string.
